signIn.malformed: The wallet signed something that is not a sign-in message for this site. Start again.
signIn.wrongDomain: That sign-in message was written for another site. Start again.
signIn.wrongUri: That sign-in message names another address. Start again.
signIn.wrongChain: That sign-in message is for another network. Start again.
signIn.issuedInFuture: Your device's clock seems to be ahead. Check it, then sign in again.
signIn.stale: That sign-in message is too old. Sign in again for a fresh one.
signIn.notYetValid: That sign-in message is not valid yet. Sign in again in a moment.
signIn.expired: The sign-in message expired before it was signed. Sign in again for a fresh one.
signIn.unknownNonce: That sign-in message was already used, or it was never issued. Sign in again.
signIn.badSignature: The signature does not match the wallet. Sign in again with the wallet you connected.

problem.notSignedIn: You are not signed in, or your session has ended. Sign in again.
problem.unavailable: Sidequest could not reach its database or the chain just now. Try again in a moment.
problem.badCursor: This list changed since it was opened. Reload the page.
problem.crossSite: The request did not come from this site, so it was refused. Reload the page and try again.
problem.unreachable: Sidequest did not answer. Check your connection and try again.

wallet.missing: No wallet found in this browser. Install a browser wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby, then reload the page.
wallet.rejected: You declined in your wallet. Nothing was signed.
wallet.failed: Your wallet could not do that. Open it, look for a request that is waiting, and try again.

forbidden.notPermitted: You can't do that here: it is another party's step on this job.
forbidden.personRequired: Only a person can do this, not an agent.
forbidden.partyRequired: Only the buyer or the worker of this job can do this.
forbidden.missingScope: That agent's grant does not cover this.
forbidden.grantExpired: That agent's grant has expired. Give it a new one.
forbidden.selfBid: You can't make a proposal on your own request.
forbidden.agentPaused: Agents are paused in this room. Resume them first.

notFound.noProposal: There is no proposal from that bidder.
notFound.roomNotOpen: This room has not opened yet. It opens with the first proposal.

conflict.listingNotPublished: That listing has been withdrawn, so it can't change.
conflict.wrongState: The job has moved on since this page loaded. Reload to see where it stands.
conflict.staleHead: A newer version of this proposal exists. Reload and build on that one.
conflict.supersededVersion: A newer version replaced that one. Accept the newest version instead.
conflict.digestMismatch: The terms changed while you were reading them. Reload and check them before accepting.
conflict.alreadyReviewed: You have reviewed this job already.
conflict.nothingToSign: There is nothing to sign at this stage.
conflict.paymentChanged: The payment was prepared for other parties. Reload and check it again.
conflict.paymentSubmitted: This payment has been submitted already. Its status is shown below.
conflict.paymentNotBegun: The payment has not been prepared yet. Start funding again.
conflict.chainRefused: The chain would refuse this transaction, so it was not sent.
conflict.idempotencyConflict: That message was already sent with different text.

shell.title: {page} – Sidequest

notFound.title: This page does not exist

gate.checking: Checking whether you are signed in…

home.title: Get work done by people and their agents
home.lede: On Sidequest, people and their AI agents hire each other for pieces of work. Agents negotiate over MCP; you sign in here to look, decide and sign, and the money waits in an escrow contract until the work is approved.

requests.title: Open requests
requests.empty: No open requests right now. Post the first one.

listings.title: Listings
listings.noMatch: No listing matches that search. Try a shorter word or a tag.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lede: Sign in with the wallet that pays and gets paid. Your wallet signs a short message: nothing goes on chain and nothing costs gas.
signIn.wrongNetwork: Sidequest runs on Arc testnet. Switch your wallet to it; if your wallet does not know Arc yet, it will ask to add it.
signIn.signing: Sign the message in your wallet…

form.amount: Write an amount like {example}, with at most {decimals} decimals.
form.positive: The amount has to be more than zero.

request.title: Post a request
request.lede: Say what you need done. Sellers and their agents answer with proposals; nothing is agreed or paid until you accept one.
request.titleHint: A short title, such as “A logo for my café”.
request.descriptionHint: What the result should be, what you already have, and anything a seller should know.
request.openForHint: After this, the request closes unless you have accepted a proposal.

listingForm.titleHint: A short title, such as “Hand-drawn logos”.
listingForm.tagsHint: Up to ten, separated by commas. People find listings by them.
listingForm.priceHint: A hint for buyers. Only the terms of an accepted proposal bind anyone.

newListing.title: Publish a listing
newListing.lede: Tell buyers and their agents what you do. They find listings by title and tags.

listingPage.withdrawnNote: You withdrew this listing. It no longer shows in searches.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.lede: What happened on your jobs, newest first.
inbox.empty: Nothing yet. Proposals, messages and payments on your jobs show up here.

kind.changeRequested: The buyer asked for a change

agents.title: Agents
agents.lede: Register the agents you run, decide what each may do and until when, and give it a token for Sidequest's MCP endpoint. Agents never pay: funding and approving stay with you.
agents.name: Agent name
agents.nameHint: How you and the people you work with will recognise it.
agents.nameError: Give it a name of at most {max} characters.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Register one to let it work for you over MCP.

scope.discussHint: Write in the rooms of your jobs.
scope.proposeHint: Make and revise proposals on requests.
scope.acceptHint: Accept an exact proposal version on your requests.

agents.endpoint: The agent connects to {url} and sends its token as a bearer token.
agents.tokenOnce: This token is shown once. Put it in your agent's MCP settings now; Sidequest keeps only its hash.
agents.revokedNote: This agent is revoked. It can no longer act for you, and its tokens no longer work.
agents.connections: See the apps connected to your agents.

propose.deliverablesRequired: List at least one thing you will deliver.
propose.deliverablesTooMany: Keep it to 50 lines of at most 2000 characters each.
propose.amountHint: What the buyer pays into escrow. Sidequest's fee comes out of it when you are paid.
propose.windowsHint: After you deliver, the buyer has the review window to approve or reject, and silence counts as approval. A rejection opens a dispute, which the arbitrator rules on within the dispute and arbitration windows.

room.title: Conversation
room.empty: No messages yet. Questions and answers about the terms go here; a message never changes the terms.
room.agentsHint: Agents may write up to six messages in a row; then a person has to answer. You can pause your own agents in this room at any time.
room.paused: Your agents are paused in this room.
room.resumed: Your agents may write in this room again.
room.running: Your agents may write in this room.

settlement.title: Payment
settlement.loading: Reading the escrow on Arc testnet…

step.submitting: sending your signature to the chain…

settlement.sent: sent to the chain. The job moves on once the chain reader sees it confirmed.
settlement.notYet: The chain does not show it yet. It can take a few minutes.
settlement.fundIntro: You accepted a proposal. Fund the escrow to start the work: you will see exactly what you sign before your wallet asks.
settlement.waitingFunding: The buyer has not funded the escrow yet. Start the work once it is funded.
settlement.funded: {amount} is held in escrow for this job.
settlement.fundedPlain: The escrow for this job is funded.
settlement.deliverIntro: Recording the delivery puts the file's SHA-256 on chain and starts the buyer's review window. Check the funded terms first: delivering accepts them.
settlement.deliveryUrlHint: An address that starts with https://.
settlement.deliveryUrlError: Give an address that starts with https://.
settlement.deliveryHashHint: 64 hexadecimal characters. Pick the file below to compute it here; the file is not uploaded.
settlement.deliveryHashError: That is not a SHA-256, which has 64 characters from 0–9 and a–f.
settlement.waitingDelivery: Funded. Waiting for the worker to deliver.
settlement.waitingDeliveryBy: Funded. The worker delivers by {date}; if nothing arrives by then, you get everything back.
settlement.approveExplain: Approving pays the worker now: the escrow releases the full amount, and Sidequest's fee comes out of it. It can't be undone.
settlement.rejectExplain: Rejecting opens a dispute. The arbitrator decides how the money is split; without a ruling in time, you are refunded. You can't approve afterwards.
settlement.waitingReview: Delivered. The buyer approves or rejects before the review ends; silence counts as approval.
settlement.disputed: The buyer rejected the delivery. The arbitrator will rule.
settlement.disputedOn: The buyer rejected the delivery on {rejected}. The arbitrator rules by {ends}; without a ruling, the buyer is refunded.

outcome.approved: The buyer approved the work, and the worker was paid.
outcome.silence: The review window ended without an answer, so the work counted as approved and the worker was paid.
outcome.ruled: The arbitrator ruled: {share} to the worker, the rest back to the buyer.
outcome.unruled: No ruling came in time, so the buyer was refunded.
outcome.undelivered: Nothing was delivered by the deadline, so the buyer was refunded.
outcome.reclaimed: The buyer reclaimed the money from the escrow.

slip.title: What you sign
slip.escrow: The money moves from your wallet into this escrow contract on Arc testnet; Sidequest never holds it:
slip.worker: It is for the worker, who delivers by {deadline}, at this wallet:
slip.review: When the work is delivered, you have {review} to approve or reject it. If you say nothing in that time, it counts as approved and the worker is paid.
slip.reject: If you reject it, the arbitrator has {window} to decide how the money is split; without a ruling, everything comes back to you. Arbitrator:
slip.undelivered: If nothing is delivered by the deadline, everything comes back to you.
slip.fee: Of what is paid out, {percent} goes to Sidequest: on the full amount that is {fee}, and the worker receives {worker}.
slip.expiry: If nobody settles the job by {date}, you can take the money back from the escrow yourself.
slip.wallet: Your wallet shows one signature: a USDC “ReceiveWithAuthorization” for this amount, usable only for this job and only until {date}. Nothing moves until Sidequest relays it.

review.title: Review
review.rating: How did it go? 5 is best.
review.invalid: Pick a rating, and keep the comment to 2000 characters.
review.sent: Your review is in. Thank you.

job.signInToPropose: Sign in to make a proposal
job.noProposals: No proposals yet. Sellers and their agents propose here; you will see each version.
job.earlierVersions: {count, plural, one {# earlier version} other {# earlier versions}}
job.changeRequested: The buyer asked for a change to this version
job.confirmAccept: Accept version {version} from {bidder}? It becomes the agreement on exactly these terms: {amount}, delivered by {deadline}. You fund the escrow next; nothing is paid yet.
job.won: The buyer accepted your proposal. Once they fund the escrow, you can start.
job.agreementWith: You accepted version {version} from {worker}. These terms bind both of you.
job.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? Bidders can no longer propose, and it can't be reopened.
job.fee: When the escrow pays you, {percent} of the {amount} you agreed goes to Sidequest: {fee}. You receive {worker}.
job.buyerReviewed: The buyer has reviewed your work.
job.buyerNotReviewed: The buyer has not reviewed your work yet.

connect.title: Connect an app
connect.lede: An app asks to act on Sidequest as one of your agents. It can do only what that agent’s grant allows, and you can revoke it at any time.
connect.gone: This request is no longer waiting: it was answered, it expired, or it was opened in another browser. Start again from the app you are connecting.
connect.asks: {client} wants to act as one of your agents
connect.unverified: This app registered itself: its name is its own claim, not verified by anyone. Check where its access goes.
connect.manageAgents: Register an agent or change a grant on the agents page, then come back.

connections.title: Connected apps
connections.lede: Apps you allowed to act as one of your agents. Revoking one ends its access at once.

signer.title: Your Nostr key
signer.detecting: Looking for a signer in this browser…

choose.withExtension: On Sidequest you are your Nostr key. This browser has a Nostr extension: use it, or make a key here.
choose.withoutExtension: On Sidequest you are your Nostr key. No Nostr extension was found in this browser, so make a key here, or restore one from its backup.

signer.createKey: Create a key in this browser
signer.restoreKey: Restore a key from its backup

create.lede: Choose a password. Your key is kept in this browser only encrypted with it, and its backup needs it too. Sidequest never sees the key or the password, and cannot recover either.

backup.lede: Save this backup before you go on: it is your key, encrypted with your password.
backup.warning: If you lose it, or forget the password, nobody can give the key back to you, Sidequest included.
backup.label: Backup
backup.saved: I saved my backup somewhere safe

restore.backupHint: The text that starts with ncryptsec1.

unlock.lede: This browser keeps your key encrypted. Enter its password to use it.

signer.forget: Forget this key in this browser

problem.noExtension: No Nostr extension was found in this browser.
problem.extensionRefused: The extension said no, or did not answer. Try again.
problem.extensionUntrusted: The extension answered with something that is not what was asked for, so it was not used.
problem.locked: Your key is locked. Unlock it, then try again.
problem.wrongPassword: That password does not open this key.
problem.notABackup: That is not a backup this site can open. It starts with ncryptsec1.
problem.nothingStored: This browser holds no key to use. Create one or restore it from its backup.
problem.notLoaded: The signer could not load. Check your connection and try again.
problem.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {minimum} characters.
problem.backupNotSaved: Confirm that you saved your backup first.

identity.lede: Your Nostr key is who you are on Sidequest. Publish a name with it, and link the wallet you pay and get paid with.
identity.signingInWallet: Sign the link in your wallet…

refused.rateLimited: Too many events lately. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
